NAME:
   sdd - Signal-Dialogue-Decision graph tool

USAGE:
   sdd [global options] [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   init       Initialize or refresh the SDD project (idempotent)
   info       Show session framing — participant, language, search capability
   config     Show and edit SDD configuration (global-first overlay with per-repo override)
   show       Show entry with upstream and downstream summary chains
   view       Compose custom graph views with filters, ranking, transforms, and renderers
   export     EXPERIMENTAL: export the graph and its declared dependencies with derived status and heat as one JSON document (unstable shape)
   new        Create a new graph entry
   rewrite    Rewrite an entry's type and kind, updating inbound references
   wip        Manage work-in-progress markers
   lint       Check graph entries for integrity issues
   summarize  Generate or regenerate entry summaries
   index      Build or refresh the search index over .sdd/graph
   search     Search the graph by keyword (--term), semantic phrase (--query), or both (hybrid)
   serve      Run the workflow MCP server: dialogue-loop tools over stdio or HTTP
   sessions   List this project's dialogue sessions with open work; abandon stale ones
   sync       Synchronize the shared graph with the upstream branch
   repo       Manage connected repos for cross-repo references
   stats      Show LLM/embedding usage analytics from the local stats sink
   help, h    Shows a list of commands or help for one command

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --version                      Print the version
   --graph-dir string, -d string  Override graph directory (auto-discovered from .sdd/config.yaml)
   --verbose, -v                  Enable info-level logging
   --extra-verbose, --vv          Enable debug-level logging
   --help, -h                     show help
